lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cu3Ag crystallizes in the trigonal space group P3m1 (No. 143), with a unit cell containing four atoms (Cu3Ag) distributed across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis reveals that both Ag and Cu centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per atom; the neighbor distances span roughly 2.84–3.07 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Cu-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between Ag- and Cu-centered polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all four sites.
